questions.text: In LDA, the beta matrix represents:
options: The probability that a document belongs to each topic
The probability that each word is generated by each topic
The number of documents assigned to each topic
The regularisation parameter for the model
questions.explanation: Beta is the word-topic matrix: beta[t, w] = P(word w | topic t). It defines each topic as a probability distribution over the vocabulary. High-beta words for a topic are its most characteristic terms.

questions.text: The gamma matrix in LDA represents:
options: The per-document topic proportions: how much of each document comes from each topic
The IDF weights for each term
questions.explanation: Gamma is the document-topic matrix: gamma[d, t] = proportion of document d attributed to topic t. Each row sums to 1. A document dominated by one topic will have gamma ≈ 1 for that topic and ≈ 0 for others.

questions.text: LDA is a supervised method — you must provide predefined topic labels before fitting the model.
questions.explanation: LDA is an unsupervised generative model. You specify k (the number of topics) but not the topic labels. The algorithm discovers the latent topics from the word co-occurrence patterns, and you interpret the discovered topics after fitting.

questions.text: You fit LDA with k = 5 on complaint notes. Topic 3 has high-beta words: 'claim', 'pending', 'denied', 'submitted'. The most appropriate label for Topic 3 is:
questions.explanation: Words like 'pending', 'denied', and 'submitted' all relate to the claim processing journey. This topic captures complaints about claims being delayed, rejected, or incorrectly processed.

questions.text: How would you use LDA output to identify which complaint topic is associated with the highest churn rate?
options: Look at the beta scores for the churned variable
Join the dominant topic (argmax gamma per document) back to the original data and compute churn rate per topic
Fit a second LDA model with churned as an input variable
Compare the TF-IDF scores of churned vs non-churned documents
questions.explanation: After fitting LDA, assign each complaint to its dominant topic (the topic with the highest gamma). Join these labels back to the original data (which includes the churned variable) and compute mean(churned) per topic group.
